acceptanceCriteria: V1-0001 explicitly maps task orientation, change consequence and evidence-carrying completion to existing accepted ledger IDs or accepts new governed rows; the spec and validator change together and no identity is inferred.
The three owner-selected Core rows each have all six use-case evidence classes, including sealed-benchmark evidence produced by V1-0012.
Corvint and Beamfall dogfood receipts bind real changes and remain distinct from hostile tests and sealed benchmarks.
Every other headline job remains literally UNPROVEN unless separately promoted.
body: Promote only the three jobs needed for the 1.0 daily workflow in the Main Use-Case Conformance ledger.
title: Verify the three Core use-case ledger rows
